texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: What is violence against women online (VAWG) or gender-based cybercrime?
texts.text: What is violence against women online (VAWG) or gender-based cybercrime?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A cybercrime  is a criminal activity that either targets or uses a computer, a computer network or a networked device
texts.text: A cybercrime  is a criminal activity that either targets or uses a computer, a computer network or a networked device

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: Gender-based violence is violence that is directed against a woman because she is a woman or that affects women disproportionately
texts.text: Gender-based violence is violence that is directed against a woman because she is a woman or that affects women disproportionately

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: Violence against women online/ technologyfacilitated sexual violence or gender based cybercrime includes physical, sexual, and/or emotional (or psychological) harm that has been committed online or through the use of ICT that is directed against a woman because she is a woman or that affects women disproportionately.
texts.text: Violence against women online/ technologyfacilitated sexual violence or gender based cybercrime includes physical, sexual, and/or emotional (or psychological) harm that has been committed online or through the use of ICT that is directed against a woman because she is a woman or that affects women disproportionately.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: What are the types of VAWG?
texts.text: What are the types of VAWG?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: HACKING:  using technology to gain illegal or unauthorized access to systems or resources to acquire personal information, alter or modify information, or slander and denigrate the victim and/or VAWG organizations. e.g., changing someone's passwords and controlling their accounts and their access
texts.text: HACKING:  using technology to gain illegal or unauthorized access to systems or resources to acquire personal information, alter or modify information, or slander and denigrate the victim and/or VAWG organizations. e.g., changing someone's passwords and controlling their accounts and their access

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: IMPERSONATION:  using technology to assume the victim's identity in order to access private information, embarrass or shame them, contact them victim, or create fake identity documents; e.g., sending offensive emails from the victim's account
texts.text: IMPERSONATION:  using technology to assume the victim's identity in order to access private information, embarrass or shame them, contact them victim, or create fake identity documents; e.g., sending offensive emails from the victim's account

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: SURVEILLANCE/TRACKING/CYBERSTALKING: using technology to stalk and monitor the victim's activities and behaviours either in real-time or historically; eg. GPS tracking via mobile phone
texts.text: SURVEILLANCE/TRACKING/CYBERSTALKING: using technology to stalk and monitor the victim's activities and behaviours either in real-time or historically; eg. GPS tracking via mobile phone

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: CYBER-HARASSMENT OR BULLYING/SPAMMING/SEXIST TROLLING: using technology to continuously contact, annoy, threaten, and/or scare the victim; e.g., persistent mobile calls/ texts; filling up voicemail with messages so no one else can leave a message
texts.text: CYBER-HARASSMENT OR BULLYING/SPAMMING/SEXIST TROLLING: using technology to continuously contact, annoy, threaten, and/or scare the victim; e.g., persistent mobile calls/ texts; filling up voicemail with messages so no one else can leave a message

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: RECRUITMENT:  using technology to lure potential victims into violent situations; e.g., fraudulent postings and advertisements (dating sites; employment opportunities); traffickers using chat rooms, message boards, and websites to communicate/advertise
texts.text: RECRUITMENT:  using technology to lure potential victims into violent situations; e.g., fraudulent postings and advertisements (dating sites; employment opportunities); traffickers using chat rooms, message boards, and websites to communicate/advertise

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: MALICIOUS DISTRIBUTION/ REVENGE PORN/ IMAGE-BASED ABUSE/ NON-CONSENSUAL PORNOGRAPHY:  using technology to manipulate and distribute defamatory and illegal materials related to the victim and/or VAWG organizations; e.g., threatening to or leaking intimate photos/video; using technology as a propaganda tool to promote violence against women.
texts.text: MALICIOUS DISTRIBUTION/ REVENGE PORN/ IMAGE-BASED ABUSE/ NON-CONSENSUAL PORNOGRAPHY:  using technology to manipulate and distribute defamatory and illegal materials related to the victim and/or VAWG organizations; e.g., threatening to or leaking intimate photos/video; using technology as a propaganda tool to promote violence against women.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: What can you do to prevent VAWG?
texts.text: What can you do to prevent VAWG?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: Be mindful of the information you share online. Be minimal and selective. Keep your accounts as secure as possible. Use difficult passwords. Don't share your passwords with anyone. If you want to take nudes, don't include your face or anything that might identify you.
texts.text: Be mindful of the information you share online. Be minimal and selective. Keep your accounts as secure as possible. Use difficult passwords. Don't share your passwords with anyone. If you want to take nudes, don't include your face or anything that might identify you.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: Require the same kind of data minimisation of the platforms you use; that they only collect as much data as they need for the specific purposes they say your data is needed for the service and that the information they have about you is accurate, up-to-date and given with your consent.
texts.text: Require the same kind of data minimisation of the platforms you use; that they only collect as much data as they need for the specific purposes they say your data is needed for the service and that the information they have about you is accurate, up-to-date and given with your consent.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: Block, remove, filter hateful posts, messages and people and report/ flag to the Admins and to the platforms themselves if you feel verbally abused
texts.text: Block, remove, filter hateful posts, messages and people and report/ flag to the Admins and to the platforms themselves if you feel verbally abused
